note: WAEC CRS round 6 (R33 top-up): Melchizedek of Salem; Enoch taken; Noah's raven first; the tree of life guarded; baby Moses in bulrushes; Aaron's almond rod; Achan's devoted spoils; Jephthah's vow; Micah's justice-kindness-humility; Esther; Job; Nehemiah the cupbearer; Anna the prophetess; John's camel-hair dress and locusts; Herodias behind the prison; the seventy return; the rich young ruler; Mary at his feet; the widow of Nain; the four thousand; the bread of life; the way answered to Thomas; Last Supper bread as his body; Peter sinking at the wind; Get behind me Satan; Nathanael under the fig tree; the cursed barren fig tree; the Gethsemane cup; Cornelius; the Macedonian call; Eutychus at Troas; Apollos with Priscilla and Aquila; the sword of the Spirit; one body many members; Count it all joy; grace sufficient for the thorn. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO CRS (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
